Centre orders audits of connected vehicles' software and devices

The Indian government has asked original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) to conduct regular audits of the software and devices used in connected vehicles. This move aims to enhance cybersecurity and ensure compliance with safety standards. The request comes amid growing concerns over data security and privacy in the automotive sector.
